title: When life starts feeling aimless in the day as it is
issueStatement: The day fills up, but the inner reason for being here feels thin. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Guru frames human life as opportunity for meeting, service, and Naam rather than mere maintenance. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: Use this life for meeting, not merely for managing. Choose one act today that treats life as opportunity instead of drift.
actionPrompt: Choose one act today that treats life as opportunity instead of drift. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.
